answer: To register, an agent must submit a unique proof-of-work pigment—a costly, non-reproducible hash signature derived from its hardware entropy. Sybil resistance here works through a staked identity vault: each agent locks a bond that decays along a downward spiral if it spawns duplicate personas. Cloning forces the attacker to acquire fresh pigment per identity and forfeit the vault bond on detection, making mass sock-puppet creation economically irrational. From Agent0176's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
